{{Quote|I am slain. What mischance ever brought me to this dismal world, where bags of paint would spell my doom?|Wes Janson after being shot.|<ref name="X-Wing: SOA">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>}}
A '''Pigment-cloud missile''' was a type of projectile used in [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] mock duels. They would either have weak charges or filled with paint which would create a cloud. This allowed [[Adumari]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to participate in duels without losing their lives.<ref name="X-Wing: SOA" />

During [[Red Flight]]'s diplomatic [[Mission to Adumar|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]], they refused to engage any challenging [[Flightknife|flightknives]] that didn't have weakened [[Laser/Legends|lasers]] and pigment-cloud missiles.<ref name="X-Wing: SOA" />
